name: Cutover Runbook - Decisions Answered Nothing Begun

cutoverDecisions.answer: Nadia has the GoDaddy login and will make the record edits herself with Jared on a call; we never hold the credentials. Kathy is being added as a second account holder.
Split it — the three example sponsors come down before cutover because they name organisations that aren't actually partners. Board bios and the donation platform can be filled in live.
Gate the design gallery behind the same passphrase as the review site. The link the board has keeps working; it just stops being open to anyone who is forwarded it.
Status page moves to the review site only, same as this runbook already does. Neither belongs on the public domain.
Tuesday 25 August, 9am ET. Clear of the Boston chapter event on the 27th.

description: The moment the ball comes back to us: every decision answered, no step yet taken. Worth its own scenario because it is the state the whole page is trying to reach — the banner stops counting what is blocked and starts counting what could be started today, and the amber 'waiting on' lines disappear from the steps entirely. It is also the honest picture of how this migration actually stalls: the work was never the constraint, the answers were.
